basic_details.job_title: BTSL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 10 Deputy Engineer, Manager Supply Chain and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: BEL-THALES Systems Limited (BTSL), Bengaluru, a Joint Venture Company under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India, is filling 10 fixed-tenure posts: 9 Fixed Tenure Deputy Engineer (E-I) posts (5 Electronics, 4 Mechanical) and 1 Fixed Tenure Manager (Supply Chain) (E-IV) post. Applications go by speed or registered post only to The Head - Human Resources, BEL-THALES Systems Limited, CNP Area, BEL Industrial Estate, Jalahalli Post, Bengaluru - 560013, and must reach on or before 15 December 2026.

application_fee.details: The fee is paid through SBI Collect at https://sbcollect.sbi.bank.in/sbicollect/icollecthome.htm?corpID=374797 (or SBI Collect Home – GOVT/PSU/COURTS – state Karnataka – PSU BEL-Thales Systems Limited), online or at an SBI Branch. Use the same mobile number and email ID as in the application form and take screenshots of the payment. Fee once paid will not be refunded, and SC/ST/PwBD candidates applying for a UR post also pay no fee.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications complete in all respects go through POST ONLY to: The Head - Human Resources, BEL-THALES Systems Limited, CNP Area, BEL Industrial Estate, Jalahalli Post, Bengaluru - 560013. Applications sent through e-mail or any other channel will not be considered, and BTSL is not liable for any delay or loss in postal transit. For clarifications, candidates may mail [email protected] ; no other form or mode of communication will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The vacancy table below is reproduced post code-wise, with the category break-up printed in the notice. Reservation for PwBD is as per the Government guidelines. For all posts: B.E. / B.Tech degree with FIRST CLASS from an AICTE approved College/Institute or a recognised University for UR, OBC and EWS candidates, and PASS CLASS for PwBD and SC candidates. The accepted disciplines are: DEE01 (Electronics): Electronics & Communication, Electronics & Telecommunication, Telecommunication Engineering. DEM01 (Mechanical): Mechanical, Mechanical & Automation Engineering, Industrial Engineering and Management, Thermal Engineering, Mechatronics. MSC01 (Electronics/Mechanical): any of the Electronics or Mechanical disciplines listed above. Fixed Tenure Deputy Engineer (E-I), DEE01 and DEM01: 4 years of relevant post-qualification industrial experience as on 01.11.2026. Fixed Tenure Manager (Supply Chain) (E-IV), MSC01: 12 years of relevant post-qualification industrial experience as on 01.11.2026. Academy, teaching or research work experience will not be counted as relevant post-qualification industrial experience. Experience shown without supporting documents will not be considered and is liable to be rejected. Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. The upper age limit is relaxable by 3 years for OBC candidates for the OBC reserved post and by 5 years for the SC reserved post. Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) having 40% disability or more get 10 years' relaxation in addition to the category relaxation. Age relaxation is subject to vacancy in the respective category in that post. Where reservation is not available for a category, candidates of that category may apply for an unreserved post if they meet the minimum eligibility for the unreserved post as on 01.11.2026. The pay is due for revision with effect from 01.01.2027. For both grades, Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, 35% of the Basic Pay as perquisites, Provident Fund and Gratuity as per the Company's rules are part of the remuneration package in addition to Basic Pay. For deserving candidates, a maximum of up to 5 additional increments may be proposed by the selection committee for approval. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.post: Fixed Tenure Deputy Engineer (E-I) – DEE01 Electronics
Fixed Tenure Deputy Engineer (E-I) – DEM01 Mechanical

content_sections.heading: BTSL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Job summary: in-depth knowledge of electronics manufacturing processes, product qualification and system-level troubleshooting, preferably in Aerospace or Defence programs, working closely with the Design Agency, manufacturing units, suppliers and customers for product realization. Interface with Design, Quality, Procurement, Manufacturing and Customers to resolve technical issues. Interpret electrical schematics, PCB layouts, wiring diagrams, BOM, Gerber files, work instructions and test procedures. Manage end-to-end PCBA manufacturing, including prototypes and production builds. Support Box Build, cable harness installation, connector assembly, chassis integration and final system assembly and testing. Support failure analysis and root cause investigation (8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, FMEA), environmental qualification, reliability testing and customer acceptance. Use lab equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers) to debug and run simulation models; prepare Military/Aerospace documentation. Awareness of ESD control, traceability, counterfeit component prevention and configuration management; must travel for on-site assembly, installation, inspection and customer support as required. Desirable: board-level and system-level debugging of analog, digital, mixed-signal and power electronics; electronics design and engineering experience; familiarity with AS 9100; SAP/ERP/PLM; ICT, Functional Test (FCT), Boundary Scan and Burn-in testing; working knowledge of IPC-A-610, IPC-A-600 and IPC/WHMA-A-620. Job summary: in-depth knowledge of manufacturing processes and product qualification, preferably in Aerospace or Defence programs, working closely with the Design Agency, manufacturing units, suppliers and customers. Hands-on mechanical designing, 3D Modelling and Engineering drawings using Solid Works; study of mechanical drawings and project documents. Knowledge of GD&T and of engineering materials used in Avionics and Defence applications. Structural and Thermal Analysis / Simulations of mechanical designs. Production planning and Material Management using SAP/ERP modules. Support environmental qualification, reliability testing, customer acceptance, and failure analysis (8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, FMEA). Prepare Military/Aerospace documentation; awareness of traceability and configuration management; must travel for on-site work as required. Desirable: working knowledge of CATIA V5, Flo-Therm Software and ANSYS; familiarity with AS 9100D and ISO 9001:2015; hands-on vibration testing of mechanical and electronics equipment. BTSL wants a highly experienced Supply Chain Manager to lead end-to-end supply chain operations in electronics manufacturing, with a record in procurement, production planning, inventory, logistics and supplier development. Desirable: MBA in Supply chain Management. Develop and execute supply chain strategies; manage procurement of electronic components, raw materials and OEM/distributor/ODM relationships. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BTSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 posts: 5 Deputy Engineer (Electronics, DEE01), 4 Deputy Engineer (Mechanical, DEM01) and 1 Manager (Supply Chain) (MSC01).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach BTSL, Bengaluru on or before 15 December 2026, sent by post only.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: A B.E./B.Tech in the prescribed Electronics or Mechanical discipline with first class (pass class for SC and PwBD), plus 4 years' industrial experience for Deputy Engineer or 12 years for Manager (Supply Chain).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BTSL Deputy Engineer?
faq.answer: As on 01.11.2026, the limit is 29 years for UR/EWS (DEE01), and 32 years for OBC and 34 years for SC (DEM01); PwBD candidates with 40% disability or more get 10 more years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the posts?
faq.answer: Deputy Engineer (E-I) gets Rs.40,000-3%-Rs.1,40,000 and Manager (E-IV) gets Rs.70,000-3%-Rs.2,00,000, plus DA, HRA, 35% of basic as perquisites, PF and gratuity as per Company rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.472 (Rs.400 plus 18% GST), paid through SBI Collect; SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-servicemen candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How is the selection made?
faq.answer: Deputy Engineers are selected through a written test and interview (shortlisting ratio 1:5); the Manager (Supply Chain) is selected through an interview, both in Bengaluru.

faq.question: Q8. Is the BTSL job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the posts are fixed tenure: 3 years for Deputy Engineer (extendable by 2 more years) and 5 years for Manager (Supply Chain).

faq.question: Q9. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: Write the Post and Post Code applied for (DEE01, DEM01 or MSC01) on the envelope sent by speed or registered post.

faq.question: Q10. Do government employees need an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates working in PSUs, Government or Quasi Government organisations must submit a No Objection Certificate with the application.
